caption: Pro presets and the incremental local index with sample results.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['embedded-text-finder']; for(const m of [...p.modals]) m.close(); p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('embedded-text-finder-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); const m=p.openSearch(); m.folder.value="Embedded Text Finder/Review"; m.query.value="blue bird"; await m.run(); await p.savePreset('Weekly bird review',m.folder.value,m.query.value); await p.setIndex(true); m.updatePro(); m.presets.value='Weekly bird review'; m.presets.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); m.contentEl.querySelector('.etf-pro').open=true; return 'ok';})()

caption: Pro export writes links to the containing note and source.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['embedded-text-finder']; for(const m of [...p.modals]) m.close(); p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('embedded-text-finder-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); const m=p.openSearch(); m.folder.value="Embedded Text Finder/Review"; m.query.value="blue bird"; await m.run(); const r=await m.run(); const f=await p.export(r,m.query.value); window.__etfExport=f.path; m.close(); await app.workspace.openLinkText(f.path,'',false); return 'ok';})()
